name: – Rasa Juknevičienė – After § 64 – Am 11
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: 64b. Expresses its utmost concern at the events of 30 and 31 July 2026 in Ceuta, a Spanish city forming part of the EU’s external border; notes with grave concern the findings of a report by the intelligence unit of the Spanish National Police responsible for immigration and border matters, submitted to the competent judicial authority, according to which the mass breach of the Spanish and EU external border was not a spontaneous migratory event but a planned operation, carried out under the pretence of a migration crisis; stresses the need to recognise the deliberate instrumentalisation of illegal immigration by non-EU state actors for the purpose of overwhelming a Member State’s border control capacity as a particularly serious form of hybrid operation against its sovereignty, security and territorial integrity; calls on the Commission, the Council and the High Representative to assess without delay the findings of the Spanish authorities and, should they be confirmed, to adopt appropriate diplomatic, financial and restrictive measures against those responsible;
